title: Forme decisions.jsonl event
description: One append-only line in decisions.jsonl — the event log the taste learner reads from. Events are THIN: they reference a card by cardId + fingerprint only; category, envelope (origin/from/role) and all other card-side fields live in the card, not here. Five types: presented (starts the silent timer), decision (accept/park/reject + measured latency + actor + optional executed commit + optional note), correction (the optional in-place edit before accepting), question (#21: the user asked for context instead of deciding — the card awaits a re-face; also the legibility metric), undo (#24: cancels the most recent decision on this card within the undo window; the log stays append-only — undone decisions are compensated, never erased).

ts.description: When the event occurred (full ISO instant; latency is derived from presented→decision ts).

cardId.description: id of the card this event is about. Join key to the card (where category + envelope live).

fingerprint.description: Card fingerprint. The drift-identity key: lets the learner group decisions across regenerations (same drift → different cardId, same fingerprint).

latencyMs.description: On live decision events: silently measured time from presented to decision (time-to-decision). Omitted on backfilled (human-era, untimed) records.

actor.description: Who made the decision. 'owner' = human. Reserved for the agency ladder: 'agent_shadow' (shadow mode pre-decides but still shows), 'agent_authorized' (authorized automation, still reversible). Distinct from the card's envelope `role` (a message role), by design.

executed.description: On accepted decisions: the git commit hash of the applied diff (execution receipt; enables rollback). Absent for park/reject. On undo events (#24): the git revert commit hash, when the undone decision had applied a diff.

note.description: Optional on decision events (#24): the user's one-line reason, captured with any gesture — park/reject rationales are the scarcest taste data. Distinct from correction (which keeps its own note alongside edited hunks).

correction.description: Present on correction events: the user's edited hunks before accepting. The one sanctioned exception to read-only.

note.description: Optional free-text reason for the correction; raw material for taste rules.

question.description: Present on question events (#21): the user's verbatim question about this card. Not a decision — the fingerprint stays un-suppressed so the runner can re-face the card with world-layer context (same fingerprint, not a duplicate). Doubles as the 'where was this card illegible' metric.

backfilled.description: true = a historical/imported record (e.g. the pre-product human-era decisions), not produced live by the runner. Backfilled decisions may omit latencyMs (untimed).
